text:
Amanda (growth): Quick idea — run a small pricing page experiment for the freemium -> paid path. Add a compact inline FAQ accordion right above the tier CTAs and surface a secondary CTA from the calculator that says 'See committed discounts'. Goal: measure lift in signup intent (cta clicks) and reduce FAQ support hits. Want to run as A/B for US traffic. Thoughts? cc @Kai (design) @Josh W :sparkles: 

Josh W: I like it. Two quick asks: 1) test copy variants — 'Committed discounts' vs 'Team pricing' (people respond differently to the word "discount"). 2) ensure we track a distinct event for the calc CTA so we can trace to signups (not just pageviews).

Maya L: I can instrument. Suggested events: pricing:calc_cta_click and pricing:faq_expand. Recommend target segment: US visitors with >=2 prior visits or referred from blog/benchmarks. I'll create experiment goal in GA/Optimizely.

Kai (design): I'll mock two CTA treatments + compact FAQ accordion. Quick Q: place FAQ as an inline accordion right above CTAs (so it's super visible) or tucked below tiers? My vote = accordion above CTAs so it reduces friction during checkout. Will post Figma links in a bit. :+1:

Amanda (growth): Prefer above CTAs as well. Target 50% US traffic, run for 7 days to get signal. We should also include a tiny microcopy under the calc output: 'Estimated monthly cost based on your inputs' to reduce confusion.

Josh W: Agreed on microcopy. Also let's make the calculator CTA non-primary (subtle) so we don't cannibalize main signup CTA but still test intent. Propose two variants: A = 'Committed discounts' (more explicit), B = 'Team pricing' (softer).

Maya L: I'll set up the Optimizely experiment and wire the events. Sample tracking snippet for devs: 
```
window.analytics.track('pricing_experiment_view', { variant: 'B', page: 'pricing' });
window.analytics.track('pricing:calc_cta_click', { variant: 'A', user_id: window.userId || null });
```
I'll push event schema to #eng-analytics and add the GA goal mappings.

Kai (design): Posting initial mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/fake-pricing-mocks — two CTA treatments + compact FAQ accordion (accordion has 3 q's: billing cadence, data retention, dedicated capacity). Will iterate after feedback.

launch-bot: Experiment scheduled: EXP-2028 | Audience: 50% US | Variants: A/B | Start window: Thu 09:00 PST | Experiment ID: exp-1718201123 | Owner: marketing/growth | Optimizely link: (internal)

Amanda (growth): Owners summary: Kai — design + final assets; Maya — analytics + experiment; Josh — product copy + acceptance criteria. Content will update FAQ copy (short answers, 1-2 lines each). Timeline: aim to deploy experiment Thursday EOD and monitor daily. Anyone want to own post-experiment analysis?

Josh W: I can pull initial analysis + conversion funnel on Monday after 7 days. Will share a short deck with CTR -> signup conversion and support ticket delta.

Amanda (growth): Awesome — thanks all :rocket: Let's keep the copy tight and the FAQ answers scannable.

Kai (design): Noted. I'll drop final assets by EOD today in the Figma file and ping #marketing.

Maya L: Instrumentation tasks assigned. I'll send event spec and rollout checklist in #eng-analytics now.

Amanda (growth): Great — closing loop here. Next check-in: pre-launch QA tomorrow 10am. :calendar:
